reason: A DSH plugin and standalone local service that bridges browser authentication to SSH targets, provides an interactive terminal and command-execution API, and exposes agent tools for remote command execution and session control.

summaries.zh: 通过本地浏览器界面连接 SSH 主机，并为 DSH 智能体提供远程命令执行及会话断开、重连工具。
summaries.en: Connects to SSH hosts through a local browser interface and provides DSH agents with remote command execution and session disconnect or reconnect tools.

capabilities: Provides a local browser interface for SSH authentication and interactive terminal access
Exposes a local API for executing commands on connected SSH targets and controlling sessions
Registers DSH agent tools for SSH command execution, disconnection, and reconnection
Handles SSH passwords and session credentials in the bridge process
